plain: A person who looks into, tests or questions something or someone

webster.text: One who examines, tries or inspects; one who interrogates a witness or an offender.

example.quote: To any unprejudiced examiner, he said, it would appear that the Constitution had provided every reasonable check, and that the authority of the Senate was sufficiently circumscribed.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 23, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
